Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That's it from the coverage of this game. History has been created and USA would look to take the cup home. The wait is not a long one, as USA and Ireland will contest on 24th December, 2021 at 7.00 pm local (12.00 am GMT, next day). But as you all know, you can join us early for the build-up. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Gajanand Singh wins the Man of the Match award for his tremendous effort with the blade. He says that he knew his side was in trouble but he took the score out of his mind and played his natural game. Mentions that he has all the support he needs. Adds that Sushant is an excellent player as well. Tells that they only planned to score runs quickly and in the end, things worked out for them. Says that the fans have been awesome and hopes that they will pull out a performance like this in the next fixture as well.

Monank Patel, the skipper of USA, is in for a chat. He says, Gajanand Singh and Sushant Modani showed great character. Adds, they kept things simple and targeted the right bowlers in the end which benefitted them. Mentions, he stuck to has plan and worked really well today. Adds, Ali Khan spoke to him before the game and said he bowl yorkers and that’s what he did in the game which worked in their favour. Adds, they believe they can make it 2-0 in the series.

Andy Balbirnie, the Ireland skipper, is in for a chat. He says that they have to get better and hope they turn things around in the second T20I. Mentions that it was a good wicket to bat on and credits the USA for playing very well. Tells that they were off with the ball but they cannot afford it and will now put plans for the next game. Adds that Tucker played very well but they didn't execute their plans well and deserved to lose.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the innings, USA had a rocky start with the blade, but a good stand between Gajanand Singh and Sushant Modani alongwith some sheer hitting from Marty Kain in the end made sure they end with a mammoth total of 188 on the board. Their bowlers later did the job and snatched a crucial victory here.

Ali Khan surely set the tempo with the ball for USA, with his electrifying pace and an early wicket of the Irish skipper, Andy Balbirnie, surely gave the home side some hope. The spinners did well to maintain the pressure in the middle overs. Saurabh Netravalkar capitalized on it and bagged a brace. Nisarg Patel and Ali Khan also picked up a brace as well. The USA players never gave up in this game and showed great character throughout.

Not what Ireland had envisioned for themselves. Ireland kept losing wickets at regular intervals and the pressure got to them eventually. Tucker fought a lone battle in the middle, he started off slowly but got in his groove eventually, but he missed support from the other end. The run rate kept creeping up and Ireland crumbled to the pressure.

USA LEAD 1-0! Yes, you read that right! Don’t rub your eyes because the result won’t change. The land of hope and pride, they say. Cricket USA can see the glimmer of hope now, as this is their first victory against a Test nation. They were missing some big names coming into this game but the youngsters stepped up and made a statement to the world of cricket. Loud and clear!
SIX! Too late for this now, isn't it? Length ball, on middle and leg. Mark Adair smacks it over deep square leg for a biggie. USA WIN BY 26 RUNS!
Good-length ball, outside off. Mark Adair guides it to third man for a couple of runs.
Full and on middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
On off, pushed through point for a couple now.
Tad shorter, around the off pole. Mark Adair nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter this time, around middle and leg. Lorcan Tucker makes room, and cuts that to point for single.
LEG BYE! Good-length delivery, on the pads. Lorcan Tucker misses his flick and the ball deflects onto the pads and rolls to short third man. Lorcan Tucker runs to the other end to steal a leg bye.
SIX! BOOM! A little too late for the sixes now, but that's a good shot! A short ball, wide of off. Lorcan Tucker stands tall and slashes it over deep point for a maximum.
LEG BYE! On a length, on the pads. Mark Adair goes for the flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and goes towards point. The batters steal a leg bye.
Mark Adair walks out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! Simply brilliant from Ali Khan! He bags his second wicket. Sees William McClintock moving to the leg side, follows him and bowls it full and on leg. William McClintock looks to squeeze it out but misses. The ball doesn't though and rattles the stumps.
Serves the yorker again, on leg. Lorcan Tucker dabs it to long on for a single.
Yorker, on middle. Lorcan Tucker drills it towards long on for a couple of runs.
Loopy ball, fuller in length, outside off. Lorcan Tucker lunges and drives it through the covers for a single.
Shorter, outside off. William McClintock drives it towards covers for a run.
Another googly, outside off. William McClintock blocks it out.
LEG BYE! A googly this time, on the pads. Lorcan misses his flick as the ball hits the pads and tolls on the leg side. A Leg bye taken.
Swing and a miss! A loopy delivery, outside off. Lorcan Tucker gets down on his knee and tries to sweep but gets beaten as the ball turns away a tad bit.
Fuller, around off. William McClintock pushes it towards long off for a single.
WIDE! Shorter, wide of off. William McClintock will let that go. Wide called.
Fuller in length, outside off. Lorcan Tucker shuffles across and plays a scoop towards fine leg for a brace.
BYE! Gets the yorker right this time, on the leg pole. William McClintock tries to block it but fails to connect. The ball rolls towards the keeper and the batters steal a quick bye.
Fuller this time, around middle. Lorcan Tucker drills it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Goes for the blockhole again and misses it again. A full toss ball, on the pads. Lorcan Tucker clips it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Misses his length, around middle. William McClintock pushes it to extra cover and scampers through to the other end.
Yorker length, outside off. Lorcan Tucker jabs it to cover for a single.
Ali Khan (2-0-12-1) is back into the attack.
Tossed up, outside off. Lorcan Tucker pushes it through covers for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Cut through covers for a run.
This is excellent bowling! Full again, on middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
Into the blockhole, on middle. William McClintock jams it out.
Full and outside off, William McClintock lifts it over covers for another brace.
Loopy ball, on middle. William McClintock pushes it through covers for a couple of runs.
Yasir Mohammad is back into the attack now.
Back of a length, on middle. William McClintock defends it to the off side and scampers across for a single. 73 needed from 30 balls.
Fuller, on off. Pushed towards covers.
Short of a length, on middle. Lorcan Tucker pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length, on leg. William McClintock looks to flick. The ball goes off the pads to square leg for a leg bye.
On the pads, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Good-length ball, outside off. Lorcan Tucker swings but misses.
William McClintock comes out to the middle now.

OUT! TAKEN! Tossed up, on middle. Neil Rock gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps it. Doesn't get the elevation he needed and hits it straight towards the man at long on. Ritwik Behera is present over there and he makes no mistake. Half the side back in the hut now for Ireland.
Commentary.Howout: c Ritwik Behera b Nisarg Patel

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on off, Lorcan Tucker reverse-sweeps it to point for one.
Full and on middle, Neil Rock nudges it on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Streaky but Ireland won't mind that. Tossed up, on off. Neil Rock tries to sweep. The ball goes off the underedge and goes through his legs to fine leg for a boundary.
Loopy ball, on middle. Lorcan Tucker works it to mid-wicket for one.
Floated it up, outside off. Neil Rock nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! BANG! Short of a length, on middle. Lorcan Tucker picks the length early and smashes it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. 100 up for Ireland! 84 needed from 42 balls.
On a good length, on middle. Neil Rock pushes it to mid on for a single.
Length ball, on off. Lorcan Tucker works it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
On a length, on off. Pushed to point.
Length ball, on off. Lorcan Tucker looks to tuck. The ball goes off the leading edge back onto the deck.
Neil Rock comes to the crease now.

OUT! TAKEN! The change in bowling works. What a wicket this is for USA. Saurabh Netravalkar bowls it short, on middle. Shane Getkate pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Ritwik Behera is stationed there. Keeps his calm, settles himself under it and takes a good low catch. Shane Getkate has to walk back to the pavilion and USA are not letting Ireland go away with the game.
Commentary.Howout: c Ritwik Behera b Saurabh Netravalkar

Commentary.Commentary: Saurabh Netravalkar is brought back into the attack.
Tossed up, outside off. Tucker punches it through point. The fielder misfields and the batters take a brace.
Flatter, around off. Getkate goes back and hits it above the bowler's head and gets a single to long off.
SIX! BANG! Floated, full and on off. Getkate stands tall and smokes it over the long off fence for a biggie. Positive signs for Ireland.
Full and around off. Tucker reverse sweeps it towards third man and gets a single.
Around off, pushed to point for a single.
Full and on off. Getkate defends it back to the bowler.
Flatter and outside off. Getkate pushes it through point and gets a single.
Floated, full and around off. Getkate punches it through point for a brace.
Tossed up, full and on off. Tucker sweeps it to mid-wicket for another single.
Full and outside off. Getkate sweeps itt o mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! All the way! Floated, full and on off. Getkate gets low and smokes it over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
Swing and a miss! Short and outside off. Getkate looks to heave it away but misses.
Tossed up, on off. Tucker defends it out solidly.
Around off, Getkate flicks it to the leg side for a run.
Tossed up, on off. Shane Getkate works it to cover.
Around off, defended out watchfully.
Shane Getkate is the new batsman in.

OUT! STUMPED! Great work by the keeper behind the stumps. Floated, full and around off. Campher advances down the track and looks to go big but misses. Monank Patel collect the ball and whips the bails quickly. Another one bites the dust for Ireland. Nisarg Patel gets his first wicket and USA are looking in control here.
Commentary.Howout: st Monank Patel b Nisarg Patel

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, full and on off. Campher pushes it towards point.
Loopy ball, outside off. Curtis Campher swings his bat but fails to connect.
Full-length delivery, outside the off pole. Curtis Campher reverse-sweeps this towards deep point for a brace.
Shorter, around middle. Lorcan Tucker pushes it towards long on off his back foot. A single is taken.
LEG BYE! Short in length, darting it on the pads. Curtis Campher looks to whip this on leg side but gets rapped on the pads. The ball rolls towards short fine leg and leg bye is taken.
Tosses it up again, around the off pole. Lorcan Tucker pushes it to long off. A single taken.
Beaten! Loopy delivery, outside off. Lorcan Tucker leans and misses his drive. Dot ball there.
Full and on middle. Tucker works it the leg side for a single.
Short and outside off. Tucker looks to chase it but misses.
On off, Campher works it towards mid on for a single.
Full and on off. Tucker works it towards fine leg. The batters collect three runs before the fielders cut it out.
Full and on off. Campher pushes it through covers.
Flatter and short, around off. Tucker works it towards long on for a single.
Outside off, full in length. Curtis Campher pushes it to the man at cover.
Outside off, tad shorter this time. Lorcan Tucker works it away towards square leg. A single taken.
Fuller, outside off. Lorcan Tucker blocks it out.
Short in length this time, around middle. Curtis Campher slaps it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, outside off. Lorcan Tucker drives it towards long off for a single.
FOUR! Serves it short this time, around middle and leg. Lorcan Tucker waits back and pull it towards deep square leg for a boundary.

Shorter, around middle and leg. Curtis Campher whips it towards deep-mid-wicket for a brace.
Tosses it up this time, around off. Curtis Campher gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Tad shorter this time, around middle and leg. Curtis Campher guides it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Top-shot! Yasir Mohammad goes short in length again, around middle. Curtis Campher hangs back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short and on off. Lorcan Tucker punches it to point for a single.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Saurabh Netravalkar strikes at the rigth time! A length delivery, on middle and off. Paul Stirling swings hard at it, but misses it completely. The ball knocks the stumps over and the dangerous Paul Stirling walks back to the hut.
FOUR! Oh, shot! Paul Stirling is on the charge here! Back of a length, around middle and leg. Paul Stirling makes room and tonks it towards long off for a four.
Good-length delivery, darting it onto the pads. Lorcan Tucker pushes it square on the leg side for a single.
On a length, on the pads. Paul Stirling tucks it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Saurabh Netravalkar serves an overcooked delivery, outside off. Paul Stirling slashes it towards deep point for a boundary.
Short ball, on middle. Lorcan Tucker goes for another scoop shot but fails to connect. Just 5 runs off the over then. Ali Khan has bowled two great overs and has got USA off to a good start.
Right into the blockhole, Lorcan Tucker digs it out.

Back of a length, on off. Lorcan Tucker looks to play the ramp shot. The ball goes off the bottom half of the bat towards the keeper. Ali Khan starts celebrating thinking that it got carried but the ball falls just short of Monank Patel.
FOUR! Good shot! Fuller, outside off. Lorcan Tucker gets low and steers it towards deep cover for a boundary.
Good fielding! Length ball, on off. Lorcan Tucker punches it towards the left of the bowler. Ali Khan moves that side and half-stops it. Prevents a single.
On a good length, on off. Lorcan Tucker blocks it to the off side.
WIDE! Length ball, down leg. Lorcan Tucker walks all the way across the stumps and looks to paddle scoop. He misses it though and the umpire calls it wide.
Short and on middle. Paul Stirling looks to pull. The ball goes off the toe end of the bat back to the bowler. A good over for Ireland. 14 runs off it.
FOUR! Paul Stirling is on a roll here. This time its tossed up, outside off. Paul Stirling carves it over covers to fetch himself another boundary. This is turning out to be an expensive over.
Full and on middle, Paul Stirling lifts it towards long off for a brace.
FOUR! Nicely done! A freebie down the leg side. Paul Stirling pulls it to fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Made it look so easy! Full and on off, Paul Stirling lifts it over mid off for a boundary.
Loopy ball, on off. Pushed to mid off.
Marty Kain replaces Saurabh Netravalkar.
Play and a miss! Good-length ball, on off. Lorcan Tucker looks to drive but misses. Excellent over from Ali Khan. A wicket and 7 runs off it.
Back of a length, on middle. Lorcan Tucker looks to play the ramp shot but misses.
Lorcan Tucker walks in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Just the kind of start USA were looking for. Ali Khan bowls it short, on middle. Andy Balbirnie stays back and goes for the pull shot. The ball perhaps gets too big on him. He picks out Yasir Mohammad at deep mid-wicket to perfection and has to depart now. Ali Khan is pumped up and will look to build on this.
Commentary.Howout: c Yasir Mohammad b Ali Khan
